mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sg_session (id, user_id, entry, source, locale, status, welcome_message, summary, last_intent, recommendations_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{entry}, #{source}, #{locale}, #{status}, #{welcomeMessage}, #{summary}, #{lastIntent}, #{recommendationsJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO sg_feedback (id, session_id, message_id, rating, feedback, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{rating}, #{feedback}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, entry, source, locale, status, welcome_message, summary, last_intent, recommendations_json, created_at, updated_at FROM sg_session WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sg_session SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
